lxc_51901f6114a6a3c2.text: People pay for their drinks when they order at this cafe.

lxc_8fef20521eb7ba8b.text: Cash is money in coins or notes.

lxc_ea9b6deeab71ff00.text: A card is another way to pay here.

lxc_448502d8a9d148a0.text: Mara takes both cash and cards at the counter.

lxc_c41c89a771c9c6e0.text: One person orders a coffee and wants to pay.

lxc_256ab62393c7692c.text: The person has a card but has no cash.

lxc_e1fd02eace76d887.text: Mara says a card is fine for this order.

lxc_d4bddfd985c5df41.text: The person uses the card to pay for the coffee.

lxc_8e668f44f8f8e60b.text: Mara says the payment is done, so the person stops.

lxc_fb3af23b91a40f44.text: A receipt shows what the person bought and paid.

lxc_bdcede261e2052f0.text: The person takes the receipt and the coffee.

lxc_3eafb5551ae92473.text: The drink is paid for, and the order is complete.

lxc_d0310d09ba894c1c.text: You are at the counter with Mara, the barista, and want a small coffee to go.

lxc_6bee13c8b4e61c59.text: This cafe takes cash and cards, and you have a card.

lxc_371fe9e6c29c6d2b.text: Your goal is to order your coffee and pay by card.

lxc_f644451986fd75bf.text: A cafe order can start with a drink name.

lxc_0666803f2009592b.text: Tea and coffee are two drinks people can order.

lxc_430bcb667eb2980e.text: A drink can be hot or cold.

lxc_0b4b1653681342d1.text: The size is another part of the order.

lxc_a9878c613f2c3eeb.text: A small cup holds less than a large cup.

lxc_d8c884bd70280d68.text: The drink and the size go together in an order.

lxc_37f5fdcefe7b23ba.text: Mara works at a cafe and makes the drinks.

lxc_677a6cee15bd65e5.text: One person wants hot tea in a small cup.

lxc_e7c04ec6c1b59e3f.text: Mara hears the drink name, but not the size.

lxc_0c2da2bc9fed9712.text: She asks about the size before she makes it.

lxc_15c31a26ac6e4dce.text: The person says small, and the order is clear.

lxc_da864853b52c1c47.text: Mara makes the hot tea in a small cup.

lxc_fb9f6c2d54624019.text: You are at the cafe counter with Mara, the barista.

lxc_ff0c9de3888d78fc.text: You want a small hot tea and will sit at a table.

lxc_ba3a389f01f8dd99.text: Your goal is to order a small hot tea for here.

lxc_3d766731a5005d91.text: You will learn cafe drinks, sizes, and how people pay.

lxc_b57c2127f56b329e.text: Then you will practise three short talks.

lxc_fa3964bfa419ee48.text: Some people drink their tea at a cafe table.

lxc_5e6d9c83ef442b48.text: Other people take their drinks away from the cafe.

lxc_8372a632fec8cb21.text: For here means the person will stay at the cafe.

lxc_17fd163127a9dd85.text: To go means the person will take the drink away.

lxc_e838c39aae08787f.text: Mara asks this before she gives someone a drink.

lxc_631b9abc4ac5a19c.text: One person orders a small tea to go.

lxc_4c4e751fd5591019.text: Mara puts a large cup on the counter by mistake.

lxc_67805b875c3910e7.text: The person sees the cup before Mara makes the tea.

lxc_29d0ee9880ec70fb.text: The order was for a small tea, not a large tea.

lxc_29886bd5d93afa50.text: The person asks for a small cup.

lxc_1011533e0a203319.text: Mara takes a small cup and makes the tea.

lxc_0a2a7323f18e07a1.text: The person takes the small tea away from the cafe.

lxc_c49ed1872f286079.text: You ordered a small tea to go from Mara, the barista.

lxc_904c8c46d971f71a.text: Mara has put a large cup on the counter but has not made the tea yet.

lxc_cefc45328aea11f1.text: Your goal is to get your tea in a small cup to go.
